warnings: No authorization policy is supplied for warehouse_operator; no authorization test or expected outcome is generated for that role.

requirements.text: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.
Each order line quantity is an integer from 1 through 100 inclusive; quantities 0 and 101 are rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.
The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.title: Create an order as sales_manager with a valid line quantity
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
The user has valid order-line data accepted by the order creation API.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with a valid order body containing one line with integer quantity 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the sales_manager role.
The response HTTP status is 201 and the response code is CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: A valid sales_manager order creation request returns HTTP 201 with code CREATED.

test_cases.title: Accept the inclusive lower quantity boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
All order data other than quantity is valid.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with one line whose quantity is integer 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the sales_manager role.

steps.action: Send the order creation request with quantity 1.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted; the response HTTP status is 201 and the response code is CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 1 is accepted as the inclusive lower bound.

test_cases.title: Accept the inclusive upper quantity boundary
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
All order data other than quantity is valid.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with one line whose quantity is integer 100.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the sales_manager role.

steps.action: Send the order creation request with quantity 100.
steps.expected_result: The request is accepted; the response HTTP status is 201 and the response code is CREATED.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 100 is accepted as the inclusive upper bound.

test_cases.title: Reject quantity below the permitted range
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
All order data other than quantity is valid.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with one line whose quantity is integer 0.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the sales_manager role.

steps.action: Send the order creation request with quantity 0.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 0 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Reject quantity above the permitted range
preconditions: A user authenticated with the sales_manager role is available.
All order data other than quantity is valid.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with one line whose quantity is integer 101.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the sales_manager role.

steps.action: Send the order creation request with quantity 101.
steps.expected_result: The response HTTP status is 422 and the response error code is QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.expected_outcome: Quantity 101 is rejected with HTTP 422 and error code QUANTITY_OUT_OF_RANGE.

test_cases.title: Deny order creation to the viewer role
preconditions: A user authenticated with the viewer role is available.
A valid order creation request body is available.
test_data: Request: POST /api/v1/orders with a valid order body containing one line with integer quantity 1.

steps.expected_result: Authentication succeeds and the request is made under the viewer role.
The response HTTP status is 403 and the response code is FORBIDDEN.

test_cases.expected_outcome: The viewer role is denied order creation with HTTP 403 and code FORBIDDEN.
